name: MOKE spot-price settlement and LP-dividend sybil claims
summary: MokeRelease.settle() let any EOA set settledMokePrice from AMM spot reserves; after dumping WBNB into WBNB/USDT the attacker settled a crashed price and claimed 43.86M MOKE on its quotas. Released MOKE could only go to handlers, so it was fed to MokeLPDividend and claimed back through 65 addresses whose LP records syncUserLP had duplicated.
notes: MokeRelease's reset is the owner pointing the X token's release contract at it (burnFromPair in claim() reverts otherwise), the last of the grants claim() needs after deployment. MokeLPDividend is a second target: its public syncUserLP let one LP position be recorded on 65 addresses (setup tx in refs), which then claimed the whole dividend.

Loss is the WBNB the MOKE/WBNB pair paid for the 43.86M MOKE swapped in distributeDividend. The pair's other 28.13 WBNB went out against LP the attacker had minted with its own funds earlier, a round trip.
